line: Bookmarks page in Settings: a new entry is now compared with stored ones on title and location together.
expected: a second bookmark to the same path is rejected
observed: Docs2 is added for the same path

line: Multi-file overflow menu: the bulk-marking entry is now handled as an on/off toggle of the current state.
expected: all items remain selected after choosing Select All a second time
observed: choosing Select All again deselects all items and the selection bar closes

line: Batch overflow menu: the invert-marking entry is now handled entirely inside the list adapter.
expected: the selection action bar closes when select inverse leaves nothing selected
observed: the selection action bar stays open with 0 selected

line: Retitling prompt: input validation for files and folders is now handled by a consolidated validator.
expected: a notice says no changes will be made because the new name matches the old name
observed: no notice or warning appears when typing the same name

line: Add note deck chooser: its initial deck is now loaded from the deck list's current choice.
expected: the deck chosen for a new note is remembered the next time the editor opens
observed: the deck for new cards is not saved

line: Card browser cards/notes toggle: each mode's display settings are now read from one shared place.
expected: notes mode uses the notes sort order
observed: notes mode uses the cards sort order

line: Timebox settings: the minutes field is now resolved from the collection's on/off state when the screen opens.
expected: after switching the timebox off and on again the limit shows 21, the value set before
observed: the limit goes back to the default 20 after the timebox was switched off and on

line: Filtered deck builder: the criteria dropdown now lists every selection criterion the scheduler offers.
expected: the order list has no retrievability options while FSRS is off
observed: Retrievability ascending and descending are listed in the order dropdown

line: Deck retitling dialog: the clash check with other decks is now computed by comparing text instead of identifiers.
expected: French can be renamed to FRENCH and the deck list shows FRENCH
observed: the name field reports that the deck already exists and Rename does nothing

line: Set due date dialog: the day and range inputs are now handled by a common text-input component.
expected: typing 1234567 leaves 12345 in the field because only five digits are allowed
observed: the field accepts all seven digits, 1234567

line: Preparation form picker: every amount field is now carried over when the form is changed.
expected: switching preparation type and back clears the previous dose value
observed: switching back resurrects the previously typed dose value

line: Settings measurement editor: submitted text is now parsed by a single number parser for every input.
expected: saving the empty field clears the weight and closes the sheet
observed: an error asks for a valid weight and the weight stays

line: Night owl mode in the group editor: the explanatory caption now builds its cut-off text separately from the remaining values.
expected: the description shows 4:00 AM, matching the other times on the screen
observed: the description shows 04:00 while the other times use AM and PM

line: Group editor first-dose picker: a picked value is now compared with the stored one before it is applied.
expected: after confirming the same start date the start time shows the start of the day
observed: the start time still reads Now

line: Shop header: large gold amounts now use a new short format for millions.
expected: the coin balance of 2,567,890 is shown as 2.5M (floored)
observed: the coin balance is shown as 2.6M, rounded up

line: Bulk clearance for unused materials: which items count as useful is now decided from crafting recipes.
expected: farming produce like pumpkin and tomato should not be listed in sell junk
observed: sell junk lists pumpkin and tomato as junk to sell

line: Gear tab slot chooser: candidate items are now ranked by their unlock threshold, with title as the tiebreak.
expected: runite chainbody (60) should be listed before adamantite platebody (66), ordered by combined stat bonus
observed: runite chainbody is listed after adamantite and slayer platebody, sorted by tier and name instead of stat

line: Profile milestones section: progress toward mission milestones is now computed from all finished progress records.
expected: dedicated (complete 5 quests) should still be in the missing list because only 4 regular quests are done, guild quests do not count
observed: dedicated is not in the missing list, it counts the 3 guild quests as completed quests

line: Combat screen stats list: the stats shown outside a fight are now calculated from fewer inputs.
expected: the attack row should show +9 prestige and hitpoints +4 prestige
observed: no prestige bonus is shown, only the gear bonus is displayed

line: Media tab blank-state illustration: its caption is now built from one constant string resource.
expected: the Videos filter shows the message No videos found
observed: the Videos filter shows the message No photos found

line: Editor line actions menu: the line-cloning action now computes its insertion point after the line break.
expected: the line is duplicated so the file reads gamma, gamma
observed: nothing is duplicated

line: File browser quick-access marking: the browser's marks are now kept up to date by its own handlers alone.
expected: after favouriting Notes.md in the details dialog, the toolbar star is in sync and tapping it removes the favourite, so Favourites does not list Notes.md
observed: the toolbar star was not updated after the dialog, tapping it added the favourite again and Notes.md is still listed under Favourites

line: Strong-emphasis hold gesture: the affected lines are now computed from the start and end of the selection range.
expected: long-pressing Bold wraps the line, giving **gamma**
observed: nothing happens, the line stays gamma and the app closes

line: Editor overflow menu typing helpers: their toggles are now applied directly to the open editor session.
expected: after reopening the file auto-format is still off and Enter adds no list marker
observed: after reopening the file auto-format is on again and Enter adds a '- ' marker

line: Editor tab width dialog: the chosen width is now applied directly to the editor that is open.
expected: after reopening the file Indent still adds two spaces, so the line has four spaces
observed: after reopening the file Indent adds four spaces, so the line has six spaces

line: Budget sheet split view selector: the active view is now stored in view-model memory.
expected: Weekly is still the selected option after the app is closed and opened again
observed: after closing and reopening the app the selection is back to Daily

line: Date badges on task rows: the badge for each date field is now built independently of the others.
expected: only one date chip is shown when start and due are the same day
observed: a start-date chip duplicates the due date
